title: Satsuma body, wheel anchors, mass and fitted tire
inputs: Identify a reproducible assembled vehicle state and list installed parts, fluids and cargo
Resolve the fitted wheel and tire object identity before measuring radius and width
Measure overall envelope independently from the body mesh AABB
expected: Wheelbase and tracks resolve to four serialized wheel-root anchors
Mass is labelled by state and is not inferred from a GameObject name
Fitted wheel radius, width and variant are verified or remain explicitly missing
toleranceNotes: Transform-derived geometry uses 5 mm tolerance. Mass and fitted tire require state-controlled evidence; candidate mesh metadata is not sufficient.
